doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Samuel Brown at Jefferson High and the letterman sweater
summary: The famous Jefferson music teacher Samuel Brown gave him no help, possibly because of his skin tone, and he joined the band only to get the free sweater.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Back then. As a matter of fact, when I was in high school, when I started at Jeff, there was a very famous music teacher there, Samuel Brown. Samuel Brown did not do anything for me period. As a matter of fact, he didn’t like me.
Well I often wondered about that. I think in a sense man, I wasn’t the right color, complexion, for Sam Brown.
Too dark. You know, just to be honest about it but, you know, -­
I know that he’s not around anymore but he took a lot of bows about me.

Oh, yeah, from what I understand, you know, and I had nothing to do -- man, the only reason why I got in the band -- Jack was already in the band but I got in the band because I got a sweater. That was the only time I had a letterman sweater from Jeff with the big J on it. That’s the only reason why I got in the band because you got this sweater free.
